description: This file defines a client for interacting with Kubernetes flow control API resources, including methods for creating and configuring the client, and accessing flow schema and priority level configuration resources.

classes.name: FlowcontrolV1Client
classes.description: Client for interacting with Kubernetes flow control v1 API resources.

methods.name: FlowSchemas
methods.description: Returns an interface to manage FlowSchema resources.

methods.name: PriorityLevelConfigurations
methods.description: Returns an interface to manage PriorityLevelConfiguration resources.

methods.name: NewForConfig
methods.description: Creates a new client using the provided REST configuration.

methods.name: NewForConfigAndClient
methods.description: Creates a new client with specified config and HTTP client.

methods.name: NewForConfigOrDie
methods.description: Creates a new client or panics if configuration is invalid.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new client from an existing REST interface.

methods.name: RESTClient
methods.description: Returns the REST client used for communication with the API server.
